description: The part of the approval card that reads the request (ui/src/lib/change-preview.ts): what it accepts of a preview that arrives as JSON, how much, the sentence for a refusal and the details without the preview, judged by ui/tests/change-preview.test.mjs. tests/ui-change-preview-for-mutation.mjs runs that file in the copy of the Hub that the runner makes. The components (ChangePreview.tsx, ApprovalStack.tsx) are judged by ui/tests/approval-changes.test.mjs and ui/e2e/approval-changes.spec.mjs and are not mutated here.

mutations.name: CP-files-more
mutations.what: twenty-one files are read

mutations.name: CP-rows-more
mutations.what: two hundred and one rows are read

mutations.name: CP-row-chars
mutations.what: a line of 420 characters is read

mutations.name: CP-hunks-more
mutations.what: two hundred hunks are read

mutations.name: CP-row-kind
mutations.what: a row of any kind is a row

mutations.name: CP-row-text
mutations.what: a row without text is a row

mutations.name: CP-row-omitted
mutations.what: every row says it was cut

mutations.name: CP-room
mutations.what: the rows of the hunks are not limited to what is left

mutations.name: CP-room-left
mutations.what: a hunk is read when no room is left
mutations.equivalent: with no room left the loop over the rows ends at once, the hunk has no row and the next check skips it: the same answer

mutations.name: CP-hunk-empty
mutations.what: a hunk without a row is a hunk

mutations.name: CP-hunk-rows
mutations.what: a hunk without a list of rows is a hunk

mutations.name: CP-hunk-invisible
mutations.what: any value says the hunk is invisible

mutations.name: CP-file-path
mutations.what: a file with an empty path is a file

mutations.name: CP-file-path-cut
mutations.what: a path is not cut

mutations.name: CP-file-action
mutations.what: an action it does not know is kept

patches.new: ACTIONS.has(value.action) ? value.action as ChangeAction : (value.action as ChangeAction),

mutations.name: CP-file-sha
mutations.what: any string is a hash

mutations.name: CP-file-sha-case
mutations.what: a hash may be in capitals

mutations.name: CP-file-unchanged
mutations.what: any value says the file is unchanged

mutations.name: CP-file-unreadable
mutations.what: any value says the old file is unreadable

mutations.name: CP-file-shown
mutations.what: the rows shown are the rows the Hub said even when it said nothing

mutations.name: CP-file-truncated
mutations.what: rows left out do not make the file truncated

mutations.name: CP-count-negative
mutations.what: a negative number is a count

mutations.name: CP-count-fraction
mutations.what: a fraction is a count

mutations.name: CP-preview-object
mutations.what: an array is a preview
mutations.equivalent: an array has no files and no refusal, so the next check refuses it: the same answer

patches.new: if (!isObject(detail) || typeof detail.preview !== 'object' || detail.preview === null) return null;

mutations.name: CP-preview-empty
mutations.what: a preview with nothing in it is a preview

mutations.name: CP-error-code
mutations.what: a refusal without a code has none

mutations.name: CP-error-code-cut
mutations.what: the code of a refusal is not cut

mutations.name: CP-error-message-cut
mutations.what: the message of a refusal is not cut

mutations.name: CP-error-array
mutations.what: an array is a refusal

patches.new: const refusal = typeof raw.error === 'object' ? raw.error as Record<string, unknown> : null;

mutations.name: CP-file-count
mutations.what: the number of files is what the Hub said even when more were sent

mutations.name: CP-hidden-files
mutations.what: the files not shown are what the Hub said only

mutations.name: CP-hidden-count
mutations.what: the files not shown are what is left after twenty only

mutations.name: CP-truncated
mutations.what: files not shown do not make the preview truncated

patches.old: truncated: raw.truncated === true || hiddenFiles > 0 || files.some((file) => file.truncated), error };
patches.new: truncated: raw.truncated === true || files.some((file) => file.truncated), error };

mutations.name: CP-truncated-files
mutations.what: a truncated file does not make the preview truncated

mutations.name: CP-sentence-not-found
mutations.what: a refusal that a file is not found has no sentence

mutations.name: CP-sentence-ambiguous
mutations.what: the sentence of an ambiguous match is the one of a missing text

mutations.name: CP-sentence-stale
mutations.what: a stale sha has no sentence

mutations.name: CP-sentence-protected
mutations.what: a protected path has no sentence

mutations.name: CP-sentence-bad-name
mutations.what: a name that is not valid has no sentence

mutations.name: CP-sentence-prototype
mutations.what: a code is looked up through the prototype

mutations.name: CP-details
mutations.what: the details keep the preview

mutations.name: CP-key-rows-dropped
mutations.what: the number of rows that the Hub hid as key material is not read

mutations.name: CP-key-rows-raw
mutations.what: the number of rows that the Hub hid is taken as it comes (a negative number, a fraction or a word)

mutations.name: CP-key-rows-field
mutations.what: the number of rows that the Hub hid is read from the number of rows it did not show
